start.speaker: Delegate Mwatsuma of Kaya Fungo
start.text: Mekatilili, the delegates from all nine Giriama clans have arrived at the forest gateway! The sacred clearing is prepared.

choices.text: Sound the sacred Kifudu drums! Let every soul gather before the council stones.
Tell them the time of whispering is over. Today, the Agiriama speak as one.

node_gather.speaker: Delegate Mwatsuma of Kaya Fungo
node_gather.text: Community Support is 100%! The whole assembly is in place. Ascend the council platform, Mekatilili; the Kifudu gathering awaits your words!

events.value: All three settlement clusters have pledged total solidarity. The entire community is assembled at Kaya Fungo for the sacred gathering.
